title: Add a small feature (Python)
prompt: Add two methods to the TodoList class in todo.py: `complete(title)`, which marks the item with that title as done and raises KeyError when there is no such item, and `pending()`, which returns the titles of the items that are not done yet, in the order they were added. Add a test for them to test_todo.py and run the tests with `{python} -m unittest -q`.
